meta.topic: Why Indian startups are choosing AI tools in 2025

scenes.narration: India is now home to over 1.5 lakh registered startups. And more of them than ever are turning to artificial intelligence to cut costs, move faster, and compete globally.
scenes.visual_note: Aerial city shot or tech hub footage

scenes.narration: AI tools are slashing operational costs by up to 40 percent for early-stage companies. Tasks that once needed entire teams — customer support, content creation, data analysis — now run on automated pipelines.

numeric_claims.claim: slashing operational costs by up to 40 percent

scenes.narration: Speed is the other major driver. Startups using AI ship products nearly twice as fast as those that don't. In a market where timing is everything, that edge is decisive.

numeric_claims.claim: ship products nearly twice as fast

scenes.visual_note: Fast-paced coding or product launch footage

scenes.narration: Even hiring has changed. AI-assisted recruiting tools help founders screen candidates five times faster. And with remote-first culture now standard, finding talent globally has never been easier.
scenes.visual_note: Video call or interview screen footage

scenes.narration: The message is clear: in 2025, AI is not a luxury for Indian startups. It is the foundation. The founders who build with AI from day one are the ones rewriting the rules of Indian entrepreneurship.
